name: Site navigation

variant.note: 'home' ships EMPTY nav link containers (homepage only); 'site' populates the four content links.

contentLinks.note: Fixed on every 'site' route: Parents, Sitters, Trust & Safety, Blog. A PageSpec cannot change this set — it is chrome, not page content.

constraints.notSticky: position:relative. The nav scrolls away with the page. No background change, no blur, no shrink — re-verified at scrollY=1200.
constraints.skipLink: a.nav_skip-link[href="#main"] is required and must remain the first child.

motion.note: mobileNav.* only fire at <=991px. navCurrentIcon.reveal is gated behind the site's single min-width:992px query and only exists on 'site' variant routes (the homepage has no .nav_link-current-icon in its DOM).

responsive.desktop: static 60px tall, margin 48px 0, transparent. Wordmark absolutely centred at 128px; Log in + Sign up at the left.
responsive.le991: margin-top 2rem. Wordmark becomes position:relative and left-aligned. A 48x48 primary circle burger appears. .nav_menu becomes position:absolute inset 72px 0 auto and is revealed by the open animation.
responsive.le479: Wordmark 112px. Button group gap drops to 1.25em.
responsive.mobilePanel: peach card, radius 24px, padding 36px, column, gap 20px, over a fixed rgba(253,249,249,.9) overlay at z-index 98. Clicking the overlay closes the menu.

notes: The 'Sign up' CTA target differs per route and must NOT be normalised: the homepage links to https://app.withotter.com/sign-up, subpages link to https://app.withotter.com/sign-up/welcome. These paths genuinely differ in the source.
/log-in does NOT render this chrome — it is a separate design system with no header at all.
